summary: This XML file defines a custom ribbon interface for Microsoft Office. It creates a new tab in the Office ribbon containing a group with a button and an editable text box, each wired up to trigger specific functions when the user interacts with them.

explanations.1: This declares the XML namespace for Office 2009+ custom UI, which tells the XML parser what tags and attributes are valid for Office customization.
explanations.4: The insertAfterMso attribute positions this custom tab right after Office's built-in View tab in the ribbon rather than at the end.
explanations.11: onAction specifies the name of a function (OnButtonClicked) that will be called when someone clicks this button; that function exists elsewhere in your code.
explanations.19: onChange works like onAction but fires whenever the user changes the text in the edit box, calling the OnEditBoxTextChanged function.
